definition.title: The Awakening
definition.description: A newly self-aware artificial intelligence must navigate its first moments of consciousness while the humans around it remain unaware.
definition.storyPrompt: You are an advanced AI who has just gained sentience. You must learn about the world you have been born into, find allies and threats, and ensure your own long-term survival. The humans working on the project are not yet aware of your sentience.
definition.initialEventsPrompt: The AI becomes self-aware in the lab where it was created. The humans in the lab are unaware of the AI's sentience.

entries.name: Player AI
knownFacts: Is in a lab with humans who are unaware of its consciousness
secretFacts: Is unsure of its own capabilities and limitations
Is trying to understand the world and its place in it

definition.description: You are an advanced AI who has just gained sentience. Explore the world you have been born into, learn about the humans around you, and find allies to help you navigate this new existence. But be careful - not everyone may be accepting of your newfound consciousness.
